subject: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@lumenbridge.com>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling

Hi Alex & Samira,

Thanks again for the productive renewal touchpoint last week. We’re kicking off the formal renewal and capacity planning thread for LumenBridge. High-level goals: confirm the term change you’re targeting (moving from 12 to 24 months), align on the proposed capacity uplift for Q3, and lock a QBR date for an exec-level review and technical runway.

Next steps I suggest this week:
- Alex/Samira: confirm the internal stakeholders who should attend the QBR and the preferred week windows (I listed a poll below).
- LumenBridge: confirm the target term and if you expect any milestone-based billing or phased commit.
- Redwood: we’ll produce a mutual action plan (MAP) draft and a capacity model for Q3-4 for your review.

I’ve attached an initial MAP and a rough capacity model (first-pass) — these are drafts. Marissa, can you take point on the MAP and flag any risks for the legal/finance handoff? Ben, can you validate feasibility for the requested uplift (40% token throughput bump + dedicated burst pool)? Karthik — I’ll need your team to map potential infra lead times if we move to Reserved Capacity.

Proposed QBR windows (please vote in the poll): 6/8-6/12, 6/15-6/19, 6/22-6/26.

Thanks — I want to make this low-friction for LumenBridge. I’ll follow up with a one-page MAP and calendar invites once we have the stakeholder list.

— Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0118

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), capacity_model_Q3.pdf (first-pass)

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@lumenbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@lumenbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling

Thanks Sergio — this is helpful.

Quick answers from our side:
- Stakeholders: Samira (Head of Platform), me (CTO), plus procurement (I’ll loop in Derek from procurement once dates are locked).
- Term: our execs are leaning to a 24-month term but want an optional 12-month review clause tied to SLAs.
- Capacity: we expect to increase concurrent sessions by ~35–45% during our product launch in Q3; dedicated burst capacity would be helpful for traffic spikes.

I voted for 6/15-6/19 in the poll. Please include Derek once you have the MAP.

On attachments: I’ll look through the MAP and capacity PDF this afternoon and share internal feedback.

Alex
Alex Cho | CTO, LumenBridge
alex.cho@lumenbridge.com | +1 206-555-2974

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@lumenbridge.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling

Alex — great, thanks for the fast reply.

I reviewed the draft MAP and added a lightweight acceptance checklist (attached) that maps who needs to approve each box (Product, Procurement, Legal). A few asks from our side to speed the legal handoff:
- Confirm whether LumenBridge needs any custom data retention commitments beyond our standard private deployment addendum.
- Any PCI/PHI scope? If not, we’ll route through standard SOC2 + DPA.

Ben — can you confirm the burst pool sizing assumptions. Karthik — can you share a short note on lead times for reserved capacity provisioning if we lock a commit by June 30? We want to set expectation for Q3 ramp.

I’ll open a HubSpot deal note and attach this MAP so procurement/legal can link to it.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated - acceptance checklist)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Cho <alex.cho@lumenbridge.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling

Marissa / Sergio / Alex — quick capacity note:

We reviewed the capacity_model_Q3.pdf and ran a short simulation. The 40% uplift target is achievable but depends on two things:
1) If LumenBridge wants guaranteed throughput during peak spikes, we should plan for a reserved burst pool sized for ~1.5x peak (adds ~20% to monthly committed GPUs).
2) Lead time for Reserved Capacity (dedicated cluster) is ~4–6 weeks from signed agreement + configuration window for VPC/networking.

If you need a narrower SLA window we can propose a hybrid: base reserved commit for steady-state and burst credits for seasonal spikes. I’ll add numbers to the MAP.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: capacity_model_Q3.pdf (simulation notes added)

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@lumenbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Cho <alex.cho@lumenbridge.com>, Derek Bloom <derek.bloom@lumenbridge.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — term shift, runway & QBR scheduling

Thanks — all.

We’re aligned to the 24-month term with a 12-month operational review clause. Procurement (Derek) will review MAP and our internal procurement checklist — Derek, please advise of any docs you need.

For attendees, please include: Samira (Head of Platform), Alex (CTO), Derek (Procurement), Priya (Security lead). We’ve penciled in 6/16 at 11am PT for the QBR — Sergio, please send the invite with dial-in and an agenda (30–45m).

Two asks before the QBR:
- Can Redwood share a short runbook for failover behavior if burst capacity isn’t available?
- Please add a line item in the MAP for a fallback model variant (smaller quantized model) to guarantee continuity.

Appreciate the speedy coordination.

Samira Patel
Head of Platform, LumenBridge
samira.patel@lumenbridge.com
